note: Two limits (docs/principles.md). A ceiling is set by the owner from what the product's consumers need; crossing one is an owner decision, never a routine raise. The growth share limits how much one PR may grow an artifact over its base; a PR whose Decisions section names the artifact passes above it. baselineBytes is a recorded measurement, not a limit.
growthReason: An ordinary feature grows an artifact by a percent or two (fn-170's fork rule: +1.1 percent on the main module; fn-152, fn-61 and fn-170 together used 5 percent in one day), while the change the check exists to stop, fn-150's first slim build, grew the field module 48 percent in one PR. 5 percent per PR lets a feature through and stops a change of that kind unless the PR names it.
